text: Imagine waking up tomorrow…
And every ocean on Earth has vanished.
Ships lie stranded on the ocean floor.
The blue planet is gone.
Whales and fish lie dying in the mud.
Gigantic underwater canyons are exposed to the sky.
Where oceans once stretched for thousands of miles…
There is nothing but silence.
Without the oceans, rainfall patterns begin to change.
Crops die.
Fresh water becomes scarce.
And billions of people face a terrifying question…
Where will their next drink come from?
Salt storms sweep across the exposed seabed.
Food supplies collapse.
Cities descend into chaos.
From space, Earth looks like a dying world.
The oceans once covered over seventy percent of Earth.
Now, entire ecosystems are gone.
Humanity is fighting to survive.
And our blue planet may never be the same again.
